items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: I used to replace her when she was working with Ridley. When she lay off like that, I replaced her. That's how I got to know Ridley.

ctx.x: Well, she played with some bands too. I don't know May's last name, but she's a better tall girl, you may know her. She worked with Ridley Tuxedo, that's where I knew her from. I used to replace her when she was working with Ridley. When she lay off like that, I replaced her. That's how I got to know Ridley. Do you remember Anna Barrett, when she worked with her? Yeah, I know. I know Anna Barrett. Is that before that or later? No, it's around the same time. I'd say before, even before. What did she? And…
